title: Read an epididymal section: lining, lumen and supporting tissue

regions.label: Tall epithelial lining
regions.observation: At this region the duct wall contains elongated, closely packed nuclei at different heights. Follow the lining around the profile rather than counting apparent nuclear rows as separate epithelial layers.
regions.interpretation: The visible arrangement supports a pseudostratified lining in this provider-identified epididymal field. Cell boundaries are not all distinct; do not assign every dark nucleus to a specific subtype.
regions.limit: H&E does not identify every epithelial cell subtype.

regions.label: Duct lumen and its edge
regions.observation: The lighter central space is enclosed by the tall lining. Material at its edge and within the lumen should be described before assigning a specific cell or functional state.
regions.interpretation: An irregular luminal profile can reflect the section through a coiled duct. This field does not establish which profiles connect or measure live transport.
regions.limit: One section does not establish which duct profiles connect or measure live transport.

regions.label: A separate vascular profile
regions.observation: This small space outside the duct contains conspicuous red cells and has a much thinner lining than the reproductive duct. Compare the two compartments in the same field.
regions.interpretation: The contained erythrocytes and separate thin boundary support a vascular interpretation. They do not identify every neighboring empty cleft as a vessel or determine flow direction.
regions.limit: This field does not establish blood-flow direction or identify every neighbouring pale cleft.

regions.label: Surrounding pink tissue
regions.observation: Outside the epithelial lining, pink tissue contains elongated nuclei. Follow its relation to the duct before naming a particular bundle.
regions.interpretation: A muscular coat and connective tissue contribute to the supporting environment. This routine field alone does not cleanly identify every pink bundle as muscle or collagen.
regions.limit: H&E here does not cleanly separate every muscle bundle from collagen.

model: First locate the tall nuclear-rich lining around a luminal compartment. Compare it with the separate small erythrocyte-containing vascular profile. Describe the surrounding pink supporting tissue without forcing every bundle into a muscle-versus-collagen label. The provider identifies epididymis; this field alone does not establish duct continuity, exact region, cell subtype or live transport.
